data.gender_notes: Miran is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Miran is derived from the word 'miratos', meaning 'admirable' or 'wonderful'. The name has been used in Christian tradition for both boys and girls, symbolizing awe-inspiring beauty and noble character. The name Miran carries the meaning “Admirable, Wonderful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Miran usually hope their child will grow to embody admirable, wonderful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miran total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
